buildCommand: cd 'Audio Engine' && npm ci && npx tsc --module es2020 && cd .. && python3 -m venv .pygbag-venv && .pygbag-venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip && .pygbag-venv/bin/python -m pip install 'pygbag>=0.9.0' && .pygbag-venv/bin/python -m pygbag --build main.py && mkdir -p build/web/assets && for f in assets/audio_manager.js assets/*.ogg assets/*.mp3 assets/*.wav assets/*.flac; do [ -f "$f" ] && cp "$f" build/web/assets/; done; true
